description: Remove schema-push.yml, replace with migrations workflow
steps: Create .github/workflows/migrate.yml with: (a) trigger on push to main (only when prisma/migrations/** changes), (b) checkout, setup node 22, npm ci, prisma generate, (c) run 'npx prisma migrate deploy' with POSTGRES_URL from secrets, (d) NO --accept-data-loss anywhere
Update README.md 'Getting Started' section to reference 'npx prisma migrate dev' for local development instead of 'db push'
Verify no other files reference --accept-data-loss or 'db push' (grep the repo)
acceptance_criteria: No file in the repo contains --accept-data-loss
README.md references prisma migrate dev for local setup
verification: source /root/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22 && cd /projects/sandbox/career-toolkit && ! test -f .github/workflows/schema-push.yml && echo 'schema-push.yml deleted'
source /root/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22 && cd /projects/sandbox/career-toolkit && test -f .github/workflows/migrate.yml && echo 'migrate.yml exists'

source /root/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22 && cd /projects/sandbox/career-toolkit && ! grep -r 'accept-data-loss' . --include='*.yml' --include='*.yaml' --include='*.ts' --include='*.js' && echo 'No accept-data-loss references'
